notes.title: Playtest of Demo version
notes.content:
The playtest build have been updated temporarily with the Demo build.
The goal is to achieve a Demo build as stable as possible for the upcoming Steam Next Fest.
I'm also approving access for 70+ more players for the playtest version.
Please, if you find any bugs, or have some feedback for the game, contact me on Discord (server link is in the main menu).
 - HungryDingo
